test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The three sides of two triangles are 4, 5 and 6 cm. Select the INCORRECT statement.

options.text: The angle opposite to the greater side in those triangles will be greater.
The area of the two triangles will be different.
The two triangles are scalene triangles.

solution:
**Calculation:**

If the three sides of two triangles are equal, then their area must be equal.

**∴ The correct option is 2.**
